body:
Phase 3 of the herdr plugin observes fleet runs by reading `.adlc/fleet-status.json`. Today that file is an INTERNAL resumable cache (fleet-orchestration spec §6.2) with no stability contract. This ticket makes it a versioned read-only observation surface so an external observer (the herdr plugin, t-herdr-9) can depend on it and fail soft when the schema moves — the plan's recommended option (a).

WHAT TO BUILD (packages/fleet)

1. In packages/fleet/lib/status.mjs, export `FLEET_STATUS_SCHEMA_VERSION` (a positive integer literal; start at 1). It is bumped only on a breaking change to the fleet-status.json shape.

2. `newStatus(...)` includes `schemaVersion: FLEET_STATUS_SCHEMA_VERSION` in the returned status object (so every run's status file carries the version). Do not change any other field or the saveStatus/loadStatus round-trip behavior.

3. Document the observation-surface contract in docs/specs/fleet-orchestration.md (in or right after §6.2 Persistence): `.adlc/fleet-status.json` MAY be read (read-only) by external observers; it carries a top-level `schemaVersion`; the documented fields are `runId`, `integrationBranch`, `baseSha`, and `tickets` (a map of ticket id -> `{ state }` where state is one of building/gating/prosecuting/fixing/merging/merged/failed/blocked); and an observer that sees an UNKNOWN or absent `schemaVersion` must degrade to polling `fleet status --json` rather than trust the file. Note it remains gitignored/evidence-ignored (writers own it).

NON-GOALS: no change to the scheduler, the resume logic, or any state transition. This is additive (one field) plus documentation.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (each with a concrete verification method)

AC1 newStatus stamps the schema version: newStatus({ runId:'r1', ... }) returns an object whose `schemaVersion` strictly equals the exported FLEET_STATUS_SCHEMA_VERSION, and that constant is a positive integer. VERIFY: unit test in packages/fleet/test/status-schema.test.mjs importing both.

AC2 the version round-trips through persistence: saveStatus(dir, newStatus(...)) then loadStatus(dir) returns a status whose schemaVersion is unchanged (=== FLEET_STATUS_SCHEMA_VERSION). VERIFY: unit test writing to a mkdtemp dir and reading back.

AC3 the spec documents the versioned observation surface: docs/specs/fleet-orchestration.md mentions `schemaVersion`, describes fleet-status.json as a read-only observation surface, and states the unknown/absent-version -> degrade-to-`fleet status --json` contract. VERIFY: a doc-content test asserting the spec text contains `schemaVersion`, `observation` (or `observer`), and `fleet status --json`.

AC4 no regression: the existing packages/fleet test suite still passes, and hollow-test on status.mjs finds all mutants killed. VERIFY: `node --test packages/fleet/test/*.test.mjs` green + preflight mutation-gate.

RAILS: packages/fleet/test/status-schema.test.mjs is frozen once authored — the executable contract for the schema-version field and its persistence.
title: fleet: version fleet-status.json as a read-only observation surface
